label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Proofread Every Email
body: Checking for typos and errors helps maintain your credibility and shows respect for your readers' time.
caption:
Even the smallest typo can distract your readers and make your message seem less professional. Take a moment to read your email aloud or ask a friend to quickly scan it before you hit send. A fresh pair of eyes can often catch mistakes you've overlooked. It's a simple step that makes a big difference in how your audience perceives your work. Make it a habit to double-check your messages! ✨
